div.div:
TriggerFunction persistsNever does
Focus confirmation object (C08)Whether the focus is confirmedAuthorize fumigation
Verification objectWhether the case can closeChange state if the object is missing
Estimation flight objectEstimated sacks for the centerCreate a packing order
Telemetry batchReading out of thresholdFix thresholds in code
Each result stores time, confidence and source object in the same case file.
